content: To the best of our knowledge only one previous work in extractive summarization has explicitly leveraged section information to guide the generation of summaries BIBREF5 . However, the only information about sections fed into their sentence classifier is a categorical feature with values like Highlight, Abstract, Introduction, etc., depending on which section the sentence appears in.
